After that, pick up the American style passkey from the floor of the pantry. If you can get your hands on the American style passkey, unlock the American style portal in the pantry. And then, make absolutely sure that the American style portal within the pantry is open. And then, head south. With that done, venture west. Okay, and then, go to the south. That done, make an effort to venture south. And then, lift the key from the floor of the garage. That's it!
